details: The brush handler fires on every mousemove and synchronously calls drawTopMarginal/drawRightMarginal, each of which removes and rebuilds all DOM nodes (strip dots + box-plot elements) without debouncing, throttling, or requestAnimationFrame coalescing—a clear Update Storm violation at 60fps. No other issues found: there are no cross-view dispatches, no zoom/resize to stale scales, no transitions to interrupt, and pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly.
